title: The Rules Timeline
heading: The Rules — cut 5, FINAL (Premiere r3 as you froze it)
intro: Final cut = Premiere r3 exactly as you left it on 2026-11-11 ("it's a cut"): your trims, the hymn fading out under the bin, the concrete-stairwell drop fading in from 22.2 s into its take, and the pen dissolving to black. Frozen; the release master is exported from Premiere itself.

beats.title: Stack
beats.see: The gang face camera at the foot of THE RULES; a tube flickers. Piano intro.

beats.title: Bed
beats.see: Night, a high street: people asleep in the bank doorway; one pulls the sleeping bag closer.

lines.name: The whole school
lines.text: We can't afford a bed for you,

beats.title: Purse
beats.see: Old hands at a till open a purse: a few coppers. Shut again.

lines.name: The whole school
lines.text: The purse is far too thin;

beats.title: Islands
beats.see: A filing cabinet asleep in a hammock under a palm. Overlay (owed): the tax line.

lines.name: The whole school
lines.text: There is room on all those islands,

beats.title: Bin
beats.see: Rain in an alley: someone asleep on cardboard beside the big green bins.

lines.name: The whole school
lines.text: But you will sleep in a bin.

beats.title: Riot
beats.see: The gang go mental: tearing the rules chest-on to camera, paper thrown up. The drop is already up (A2).

beats.title: Hang
beats.see: Two rip paper right up in the lens while two hang off the top racks and one hauls himself up behind (clip from HR7-d-b).

beats.title: Climb
beats.see: They climb the shelving and tear the archive apart; paper pours down.

beats.title: Pen
beats.see: A blank page and a pen held out to camera. The drop plays out under it.
